- Unresolved source gap: Big-O notes missing. Quiz 3 unread.
- Persistence: study/cs-101/quiz-4/learning-record.md
'''

assert p.read_bytes()==c.read_bytes()
saved=io.read_record(p)
print('Verified sections:',[s[0] for s in io.split_sections(saved['content'])[1]])
